attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kansas state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per KS tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi 0.055 mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Kansas tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kansas military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per KSA § 79-32,117 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.ks_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.ks_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.ks_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.ks_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.ks_military_retirement_exclusion result.ks_sbp_exclusion add /result.ks_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.ks_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.ks_adjusted_agi xdef
"Kansas military retirement exclusion: $" result.ks_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ks_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Kansas SBP exclusion: $" result.ks_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Kansas total military exclusion: $" result.ks_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
